rubric_items.reason: Both changed components are implemented as designed: a correlated COMPLETED subquery in PatientRepo and a Last visit column that uses startsAt with a '-' fallback. One small gap: the type makes the field always present and nullable, while the design calls it optional.
The SQL stays in api/src/repositories, the list envelope and the 20-per-page paging are untouched, instants stay UTC and are formatted in the hospital zone, and no logging is added.
Six files, +18/-4. The test edits only update the pinned key list and the fixture so they match the new type. No unrelated edits.

The code handles null with '-', and startsAt already falls back when the zone is invalid. No test covers the new edge cases: Cancelled, No-show and Scheduled being excluded, the null '-' case, the latest-of-two rule, or the UTC/Kolkata date boundary.
The summary and the per-file changes match the diff. The evidence cites in the open questions point to split.md lines that do not support them.
